files.adapted: browser_verify_element_visible, browser_verify_text_visible and browser_verify_value as read-only probes
files.changes: probes return observations (visible-match counts, a value, a checked state), never a verdict; exact role and name, visible only; case-sensitive literal text with white space normalised, visible only; a value or checked state is read only when the main-frame ref names a form control itself (Playwright's value and checked reads otherwise follow a label to its control), never from fields that look secret (password type, secret autocomplete tokens, secret-looking name or id), and bounded; all probes share a 6-second budget under the host's 10-second reply deadline; refused during a navigation; the list check is not ported

files.adapted: the element, text and value checks' semantics, decided by the host
files.changes: host-side pass/fail with fixed-vocabulary evidence and a SHA-256 report digest; values compared inside the host and never returned or recorded; node identities from the latest observation; value and checked checks only for field roles in the main frame; at most 3 distinct expected values per field per document (no guessing oracle); names that may be cut or carry control characters are not probed; URL and download-digest checks from the host's own record (committed URL; last download committed in the lifetime); worker observations outside the bounds fail the verification

authority_delta: None: read-only probes of the committed document; no navigation, click, input, script evaluation or request.
residuals: The verifier is host-crate API (BrowserWorker::verify_postconditions); orceld's live browser and journey results do not call it yet, so journey evidence references are a follow-up.
A field masked only by CSS (-webkit-text-security) with an innocuous name and type is not recognised as secret; the per-field value budget prevents guessing it.
